- \( \theta_1 = 40^\circ \)

\[ \theta_2 = \arcsin(0.4285) \approx 25.47^\circ \]

\[ v_{\text{rms}} = \sqrt{\frac{3RT}{M}} \]
where \(R\) is the molar gas constant, \(T\) is the temperature in Kelvin, and \(M\) is the molar mass of the gas in kg/mol.

Step 2: Substitute the given values into the formula.
Given:
- \(R = 8.314 \, \text{J/(mol·K)}\)
- \(T = 300 \, \text{K}\)
- Molar mass \(M = 4 \, \text{g/mol} = 4 \times 10^{-3} \, \text{kg/mol}\)

Step 3: Calculate the rms speed.
\[ v_{\text{rms}} = \sqrt{\frac{3 \times 8.314 \, \text{J/(mol·K)} \times 300 \, \text{K}}{4 \times 10^{-3} \, \text{kg/mol}}} \]

Step 4: Simplify the expression inside the square root.
\[ v_{\text{rms}} = \sqrt{\frac{3 \times 8.314 \times 300}{4 \times 10^{-3}}} \]
\[ v_{\text{rms}} = \sqrt{\frac{7482.6}{4 \times 10^{-3}}} \]
\[ v_{\text{rms}} = \sqrt{1870650} \]
\[ v_{\text{rms}} \approx 1367.7 \, \text{m/s} \]

Final answer: 1367.7 m/s
